# Vortex

Vortex allows an arbitrary accent colour and styles headings with neon glow, per-level colours and gradient underlines. Its recorded description also covers animated and coloured internal and external links, and unique icon callouts meant to make organization clearer.

![Vortex screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhimangs/obsidian-vortex/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vortex"
    author: "abhimangs"
    repo:   "abhimangs/obsidian-vortex"
    slug:   "vortex"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vortex"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/abhimangs/obsidian-vortex"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhimangs/obsidian-vortex/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Customize infinite accent colors and style headings with neon glow, per-level colors, and gradient underlines. Animate and color internal/external links, and insert unique icon callouts for clearer organization."
}
```
